title: BPW-2026-0521
text:
[BUREAU OF CONTRACT ADMINISTRATION]
BPW-2026-0521
CD ALL
TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) – CONTENT MANAGEMENT/CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT SERVICES
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Inspector of Public Works to issue the transmitted TOS for on-call consultants on the Information Technology Agency’s bench contract for Content Management/Customer Relationship Management Services; and
AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Contract Administration to evaluate pre-qualified respondents based upon the requirements and procedures set forth in the TOS.
summary: Authorization for Inspector of Public Works to issue task order solicitation for content management and customer relationship management services from Information Technology Agency's bench contract.
